concerns.text: T027 defines the sensitivity sweep thresholds as '{0.05, 0.1}' but spec.md:US3-Scenario-2 explicitly mandates the set '{0.01, 0.05, 0.1}'. Omitting 0.01 violates FR-007's requirement to sweep a 'representative range' and fails the acceptance criterion for robustness testing.

T012 requires loading a '5D tensor' of shape '[num_images, num_timesteps, num_blocks, history_dim]' into memory. This contradicts spec.md:Assumptions and plan.md:Technical Context which mandate 'on-the-fly aggregation' and 'batching' to stay under 7GB RAM. Loading all images simultaneously risks OOM, violating SC-005 and the memory constraints of the GitHub Actions runner.

T025 mandates re-executing the benchmark 5 times with different seeds but does not explicitly require re-running the clustering/derivation (T012/T013) for each seed. Spec.md:US3-Scenario-1 and Constitution Principle VI require the static map to be robust; if the map is derived once on Set A and reused for all 5 seeds, the statistical test measures seed variance in generation, not the robustness of the map derivation itself, weakening the FR-006 validation.

T011 specifies saving 'routing_{image_id}.npy' files but the verification step checks for shape '[100, num_blocks, history_dim]'. The spec (FR-001) requires recording weights for 'every block and timestep' but does not hardcode 100 timesteps. Hardcoding '100' in the verification schema creates a brittle constraint that may fail if the timestep schedule changes, violating the flexibility required by the research phase.
